body.description: weathered red barn covered in vines with solar panels on the roof, post-apocalyptic solarpunk, 2.5D top-down view, high overhead camera looking down at a steep angle so you mostly see the roof from above with only a short front wall strip along the bottom, like a building in Zelda A Link to the Past or a classic SNES top-down RPG overworld, footprint flat on the ground tiles, no side walls visible, not isometric, pixel art, transparent background
